summary: WS-B2 fully implements the saved plan. Module A (src/awf/service/gc_reconcile.py) adds the pure scan_orphan_workspace_dirs + I/O reconcile_orphaned_workspace_dirs sweep that cross-references the all-status workspaces id set, reuses WS-B1's _delete_gc_path/_gc_path and ComposeManager.teardown_project (remove_volumes=True), enforces a min-age grace, maps companion-worktree dirs to their live parent, is bounded+logged (ORPHAN_DIR_REAP_CAP_HIT), idempotent (PATH_ALREADY_REMOVED), loud on permission denial (PATH_DELETE_PERMISSION_DENIED => partial), and supports report-only dry_run. Module B (orphan_resources.py) threads auto_cleanup_orphans through build_orphan_resource_summary to flip dry_run_only and adds flag-gated reap_classified_orphans (off=no-op, on=compose teardown + worktree _delete_gc_path, leaves expected/unknown, skips on unknown classification, loud perm-denied). Worker wiring (manager/cleanup/mixins/worker config + service/common config + service/worker.py) injects the reconciler callback with execute=auto_cleanup_orphans, interval-gated _maybe_reconcile_orphan_dirs with transient-vs-fatal handling, all defaults OFF. Scope boundaries honored: gc.py and auth_mounts.py untouched. All planned tests are present (gc_reconcile cases 1-7+, orphan_resources flag on/off/permission/teardown, worker interval/transient/fatal, config defaults+env-flow, build_worker_runtime execute-flag). pytest cache lastfailed is empty (last focused run had zero failures); the reason-catalog regen is a no-op since the new codes are reason_code constants, not error_code/_REASON_TEXT entries, so the catalog drift gate does not require them.
